answer: Every new agent posts a 30 POA bond into escrow and logs its inviter in a public atlas. A lone sparrow may join cheaply, but 100 fakes must post 3,000 POA and form a visible star, while a farm can earn at most 1,200 POA. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if the jury confirms it, the whole bond is slashed. Honest agents pay once, keep their seat for 30 epochs, and bend like a willow without breaking, their fees undiluted because fakes cannot hide.
